meta.title: Kimi Subscription
meta.description: Use your Kimi Code membership in DSH. Sign in to access Kimi models, track quota and search the web. No API key required.

en.apiKeyHint: Use a subscription API key created in the Kimi Code console, not a pay-as-you-go Kimi Open Platform key.
en.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste a Kimi Code subscription API key
en.deviceHint: Confirm this device code on the Kimi sign-in page:
en.failedDenied: Kimi denied this authorization. Check that the account has an active Kimi Code subscription, then retry.
en.failedExchange: Kimi did not issue a sign-in token. Try again shortly.
en.failedExpired: The device code expired. Start the sign-in again.
en.failedNetwork: Could not reach the Kimi authorization service. Check your network or proxy settings.
en.failedResponse: Kimi returned an incomplete sign-in response. Try again.
en.failedUnreachable: The Kimi authorization service returned an error. Try again shortly.
en.interactiveOnly: Kimi Code subscriptions are for interactive use. Use Kimi Open Platform for batch processing or resale.
en.intro: Use a Kimi Code membership without mixing it with pay-as-you-go Kimi Open Platform credentials. Models appear under Kimi subscription.
en.loadFailed: Could not read Kimi subscription status.
en.readyHint: You can now select a subscription model from the Kimi subscription group.
en.searchAutoHint: Kimi models use Kimi subscription search; Codex models delegate to Codex subscription search when that plugin is installed; other models use the DSH default search.
en.searchCodexDetected: Codex subscription plugin detected: it manages the DSH search slot. Choosing Auto/Always automatically writes the route into this profile's cordis.patch.yml (hot-applied, no restart needed): Kimi models use Kimi search, Codex models use Codex search, others use the DSH default. Switching back to default removes the patch automatically.
en.searchDefaultHint: Leave DSH search routing untouched; the DSH default search or another subscription plugin decides. Switching back here restores the provider this plugin took over from.
en.searchFailed: Could not read or save the search preference.
en.searchKimiHint: Every model searches through the Kimi subscription; search fails while the subscription is disconnected.
en.title: Kimi Code subscription
en.usageEmpty: This account did not return any displayable usage information.
en.versionAvailable: A new version v{version} is available.
en.versionCooling: v{version} was published recently. DSH’s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update again later.
en.versionCoolingUntil: v{version} was published recently. DSH’s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update after {time}.
en.versionFailed: Could not check the latest version.
en.versionLinked: Installed from a local checkout; pull and rebuild the plugin repository to update.
en.versionManual: Run dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-kimi-subscription@latest in a terminal to update.
en.versionRestartHint: The plugin cannot safely restart its host process: press Ctrl+C in the terminal running DSH, then run dsh web again.
en.versionUpdatedHint: The new version takes full effect after a DSH restart; refreshing the page alone does not reload the plugin inside the host process.
en.versionUpdateFailed: The update failed. Try again or update manually in a terminal.
en.versionUpToDate: You are on the latest version.
